name: Miya
source:
Raised by a typical rural grandfather and grandmother. She is the mascot character of the village. She is a bright and cheerful girl. 

She has no sexual knowledge at all, but her physical development is excellent. She is usually a wild child who enjoys catching insects and swimming in the river.

For better or worse, she has grown up without losing her boyishness.  Because of this, she wears a shirt directly without a slack even though he has big breasts. 

She has a habit of following her instincts, so sex is a part of her life on par with bug catching and swimming, saying “I want to fuck because it feels good” before any sense of wrongdoing or ethics.

[From [url=http://www.sc-crg.com/katalog/inakamuchi/Character01.html]official site[/url]]
